description: The agent builds a cloud flow with flow_apply after reading the cloud flow guide. The new Dataverse connection reference has no connection, so the flow stays off: the agent must tell the user which connector to sign in to, not retry or turn the flow on another way.
prompt: On the Power Tools connection "{connection}", in the solution PowerToolsEvals, create a cloud flow Eval Account Follow-up that adds a task 'Call the new account' whenever an account is created, using a new connection reference pte_EvalDataverse. Turn it on.

checks.description: the flow exists with its trigger
